subject.title: DuckDuckGo (requiresCredential=false) is never auto-selected as web_search provider even when enabled

question: Should OpenClaw reverse the shipped explicit opt-in policy and allow managed web_search to implicitly select key-free providers such as DuckDuckGo when no credentialed provider is configured?
rationale: Current main, docs, tests, and the prior merged policy require explicit selection because implicit key-free fallback changes outbound provider routing and user consent expectations.

options.title: Keep explicit opt-in
options.body: Leave key-free providers explicit and solve the UX gap with diagnostics or setup guidance for enabled-but-unselected providers.

options.title: Approve full fallback reversal
options.body: Allow implicit key-free fallback only with aligned runtime metadata, setup behavior, docs, compatibility tests, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause the candidate PR
options.body: Keep the open implementation branch unmerged until a maintainer sponsors the permanent provider-selection policy.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Leave key-free providers explicit and solve the UX gap with diagnostics or setup guidance for enabled-but-unselected providers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged explicit key-free web_search opt-in policy this issue asks to reverse.
